I have been working on this engine on and off for a while since I posted my last engine on reddit almost a year ago. That engine was crap to say the least but I learned a lot and I am very proud of what I have now. S2DEC is written in C++ using mostly C++11 features. I have been neglecting to post the engine for a while now because I always felt like there was more I should add before letting other people look at it. I finally sucked it up and posted it on the SFML forums the other night so I might as well post it here too. There is a short tutorial about how to use the engine in that link.

Assuming it's stored in the bottle and at a stable temperature (e.g. refrigerator, basement, etc). Does it vary by style?
How long will stored beer last?

A couple of years ago I helped clean out my in-laws garage. Found a case of beer that was at least twenty years old. I threw it away into a large trash bin we rented. A Mexican guy was going thru the trash and found the beer. He asked if it was still good. I said no it's mal. He cracked one open and said still good. He took the case home.
It varies with style, mostly because of the hops. Highly hopped beers will become a little syrupy on mouth feel over time as the hop oils break down. Darker ales will last almost indefinitely.

This is the best and most informed answer; darker ales kept in a stable environment will literally last forever. Beer is like sugar and honey, it really doesn't go bad, the flavors will change over time but because of its' antimicrobial properties it will stand the test of time.
Higher ABV beers store better than lower ABV beers as a general rule.
